# SHAI-HULUD adaptive VP — measured results (generated by `experiments/analyze.py`)

All numbers are read from `results/*.json`.  Units: box 1, total mass 1, 4πG = 1, t on a static background.
`x_rms`, `p_rms`: RMS error against the 4096² grid-matched particle control; for sheets it is the error of the
**carrier evaluated on a uniform 256² label lattice** (not only at nodes); for N-body it is the error at the particles
that share labels with the control lattice.  `rho`: ‖ρ−ρ_ref‖₂/‖ρ_ref−1‖₂ on the PM grid.  `F`: relative L2 error of the
PM acceleration field.  `RSS+`: peak resident memory above the baseline measured after imports and JIT warm-up.
`state`: bytes of persistent evolving state (N-body: x, p; sheet: nodal d, p, Σ, key + carrier coefficients).

## 0. Baseline reproduction (original code, this environment)

* 512² control at PM 64²: bit-identical to the saved snapshot: **True**
* arms nbody/n128, sheet-cub/n32s4, sheet-quin/n64s2, href-cub/32to64@150: largest relative deviation of (x_rms, p_rms, rho, E) from the saved JSON: **0.0e+00**
* frozen conventions: `{"time_variable": "t (static background, no expansion)", "integrator": "KDK, field solved after the drift", "dt": 0.01, "nsteps": 300, "pm_grid": 64, "kernel": "PCS (order 4)", "force_law": "grad", "ic": "GrowingModeIC(eps=(0.10,0.07,0.03), phase=0.9)", "units": "L=1, total mass 1, 4 pi G = 1"}`
